name: aidlc-claude-code-dev
description: Dev-only tooling for the AIDLC framework — not part of the distributable. The shipped framework lives at aidlc-claude-code/.claude/ and is copied into user projects via `cp -r aidlc-claude-code/.claude/ your-project/.claude/` (see README.md). All framework hooks and tools run via bun without requiring this package; bun-types here only powers contributor LSP coverage.
